/** Independent registry/context boundary using the frozen Task03A authority contract. */
import { ConvexError, v, convexToJson, type GenericValidator, type Value, type JSONValue } from "convex/values";
import type { QueryCtx, MutationCtx } from "./_generated/server";
import type { Doc } from "./_generated/dataModel";
import type { RuntimeAuthority, RuntimeAuthorityRequirement, RuntimeCapability, RuntimeResource } from "../src/auth/verified";
import { resolveAuthority, resolveAuthorityReference, createAuthorityReader, type AuthorityReader, type TombstoneKey } from "./runtimeAuth";
import schema from "./schema";

export const selectors = { tenantId: v.optional(v.string()), memorySpaceId: v.optional(v.string()) };
export type Selectors = { tenantId?: string; memorySpaceId?: string };
export type RegistryCtx = Pick<QueryCtx, "db" | "auth">;
export function deny(code = "FORBIDDEN"): never {
  throw new ConvexError({ version: 1, code, message: "Access denied or invalid registry input", retryable: false, outcome: "not_dispatched" });
}
const attemptedEffects = new WeakSet<RegistryCtx>();
const safeCodes = ["UNAUTHENTICATED", "FORBIDDEN", "INVALID_INPUT", "CAPABILITY_NOT_READY"] as const;
type SafeCode = typeof safeCodes[number];
const safeMessages: Record<SafeCode, readonly string[]> = {
  UNAUTHENTICATED: ["Verified identity required", "Access denied or invalid registry input"],
  FORBIDDEN: ["Access denied", "Access denied or invalid registry input"],
  INVALID_INPUT: ["Invalid authority configuration", "Access denied or invalid registry input"],
  CAPABILITY_NOT_READY: ["Access denied or invalid registry input"],
};
const envelopeKeys = ["version", "code", "message", "retryable", "outcome"];
const nativeStack = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(new Error("Registry operation failed"), "stack");
function exactOwnKeys(value: object, expected: readonly PropertyKey[]): PropertyKey[] | null {
  const keys = Reflect.ownKeys(value);
  return keys.length === expected.length && keys.every((key) => expected.includes(key)) ? keys : null;
}
function ownData(value: object, key: PropertyKey): unknown {
  const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, key);
  return descriptor && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(descriptor, "value") ? descriptor.value : undefined;
}
function ordinaryStack(error: object): boolean {
  const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(error, "stack");
  if (!descriptor) return false;
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(descriptor, "value")) return typeof descriptor.value === "string";
  // Node24/V8 lazily materializes stack via a shared intrinsic accessor. Do not invoke it.
  return typeof nativeStack?.get === "function" && descriptor.get === nativeStack.get && descriptor.set === nativeStack.set;
}
/** Inspection itself is untrusted. Capture only static own descriptors once; never invoke
 * getters or reread the thrown value after validating its fixed literal code. Native stack
 * diagnostics (including V8's lazy stack accessor) are never materialized or returned. */
function classifyFailure(error: unknown): { code: SafeCode | null; ambiguous: boolean } {
  const unknown = { code: null, ambiguous: false };
  try {
    if (!error || typeof error !== "object") return unknown;
    const message = ownData(error, "message");
    if (typeof message !== "string" || !ordinaryStack(error)) return unknown;
    if (error instanceof ConvexError) {
      if (!exactOwnKeys(error, ["stack", "message", "name", "data", Symbol.for("ConvexError")])
        || ownData(error, "name") !== "ConvexError" || ownData(error, Symbol.for("ConvexError")) !== true) return unknown;
      const data = ownData(error, "data");
      if (!data || typeof data !== "object") return unknown;
      const prototype: unknown = Object.getPrototypeOf(data);
      if (prototype !== null && prototype !== Object.prototype) return unknown;
      const keys = exactOwnKeys(data, envelopeKeys); if (!keys) return unknown;
      const captured: Record<string, unknown> = Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key) => [key, ownData(data, key)] as const));
      // Compatibility with the dedicated control-reader protocol:
      // ambiguity stays distinct from a permission decision so admission cannot prune
      // it into another scope. Accept only this exact static whole envelope.
      if (captured.code === "AUTHORITY_LOOKUP_AMBIGUOUS") {
        if (captured.version !== 1 || captured.message !== "Authority lookup is ambiguous"
          || captured.retryable !== false || captured.outcome !== "not_dispatched"
          || message !== JSON.stringify(captured)) return unknown;
        return { code: null, ambiguous: true };
      }
      const code = safeCodes.find((candidate) => candidate === captured.code);
      if (!code || captured.version !== 1 || typeof captured.message !== "string" || !safeMessages[code].includes(captured.message)
        || captured.retryable !== false || captured.outcome !== "not_dispatched" || message !== JSON.stringify(captured)) return unknown;
      return { code, ambiguous: false };
    }
    // Only the installed ordinary QueryImpl.unique protocol is a known ambiguity.
    if (error instanceof Error && exactOwnKeys(error, ["stack", "message"])
      && message.startsWith("unique() query returned more than one result from table ")) return { code: null, ambiguous: true };
    return unknown;
  } catch { return unknown; } // Proxy/prototype/descriptor traps cannot escape this boundary.
}
function safeErrorCode(error: unknown): SafeCode | null { return classifyFailure(error).code; }
async function controlRead<T>(run: () => Promise<T>, referenceOnly = false): Promise<T> {
  try { return await run(); }
  catch (error) {
    // These adapter bodies only read the database: every thrown read is a backend failure,
    // even if its envelope resembles a policy denial. Real resolver policy decisions occur
    // outside this boundary and remain eligible for ordinary candidate pruning/optional READ.
    // Classified codes never become low-level permission decisions. Only pinned reference
    // checks, which cannot select a peer, retain the established exact/native ambiguity denial.
    const failure = classifyFailure(error); const code = referenceOnly && failure.ambiguous ? "FORBIDDEN" : null;
    // Never hand the original diagnostic back to the resolver for another property read.
    throw new ConvexError({ version: 1, code: code ?? "REGISTRY_OPERATION_FAILED",
      message: code ? "Access denied or invalid registry input" : "Registry operation failed",
      retryable: false, outcome: code ? "not_dispatched" : "failed" });
  }
}
function registryReader(ctx: RegistryCtx, referenceOnly = false): AuthorityReader {
  const base = createAuthorityReader(ctx);
  return {
    findPrincipal: async (issuer, subject) => await controlRead(async () => await base.findPrincipal(issuer, subject), referenceOnly),
    getPrincipal: async (id) => await controlRead(async () => await base.getPrincipal(id), referenceOnly),
    listMemberships: async (id) => await controlRead(async () => await base.listMemberships(id), referenceOnly),
    getMembership: async (id) => await controlRead(async () => await base.getMembership(id), referenceOnly),
    listGrants: async (id) => await controlRead(async () => await base.listGrants(id), referenceOnly),
    getGrant: async (id) => await controlRead(async () => await base.getGrant(id), referenceOnly),
    getScope: async (tenant, space) => await controlRead(async () => await base.getScope(tenant, space), referenceOnly),
    hasTombstone: async (key) => await controlRead(async () => await base.hasTombstone(key), referenceOnly),
  };
}
async function requireRegistryAuthority(ctx: RegistryCtx, requirement: RuntimeAuthorityRequirement) {
  return await resolveAuthority(registryReader(ctx), await controlRead(async () => await ctx.auth.getUserIdentity()), requirement);
}
/** Every selected native handler normalizes private errors without turning failures into success. */
export async function operation<T>(ctx: RegistryCtx, kind: "query" | "mutation", run: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  try { return await run(); }
  catch (error) {
    const failure = classifyFailure(error);
    const attempted = attemptedEffects.has(ctx);
    if (failure.code || failure.ambiguous) throw new ConvexError({ version: 1, code: failure.code ?? "FORBIDDEN",
      message: "Access denied or invalid registry input", retryable: false, outcome: attempted ? "rolled_back" : "not_dispatched" });
    throw new ConvexError({ version: 1, code: "REGISTRY_OPERATION_FAILED", message: "Registry operation failed",
      retryable: false, outcome: kind === "mutation" && attempted ? "rolled_back" : "failed" });
  } finally { attemptedEffects.delete(ctx); }
}
/** Mark a real write attempt before invoking the native writer, including a rejected first attempt. */
export async function effect<T>(ctx: RegistryCtx, run: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  attemptedEffects.add(ctx); return await run();
}
export function textId(value: string): string { if (!value.trim()) deny("INVALID_INPUT"); return value; }
export function integer(value: number, min = 0, max = 1000): number {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < min || value > max) deny("INVALID_INPUT"); return value;
}
export function nextVersion(value: number): number { integer(value, 1, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1); return value + 1; }
export function distinct(values: string[]): void { values.forEach(textId); if (new Set(values).size !== values.length) deny("INVALID_INPUT"); }
export function record(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
  const prototype: unknown = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  return prototype === null || typeof prototype === "object" && prototype !== null
    && (prototype as { constructor?: { name?: string } }).constructor?.name === "Object";
}
export function mergeValue(previous: unknown, patch: unknown): unknown {
  json(patch); if (patch === undefined) return previous;
  return record(previous) && record(patch) ? { ...previous, ...patch } : patch;
}
export function nativeJson(value: unknown): JSONValue {
  try {
    // This narrow unknown-value seam delegates validation to Convex's official codec.
    // The cast permits the codec to reject unsupported values; it asserts no authority/receipt.
    return convexToJson(value as Value);
  } catch { return deny("INVALID_INPUT"); }
}
export function json(value: unknown): void {
  if (value !== undefined) nativeJson(value);
}
function matches(value: unknown, validator: GenericValidator): boolean {
  switch (validator.kind) {
    case "any": try { json(value); return true; } catch { return false; }
    case "string": return typeof value === "string";
    case "id": return typeof value === "string" && value.trim().length > 0;
    case "float64": return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value);
    case "boolean": return typeof value === "boolean";
    case "literal": return value === validator.value;
    case "null": return value === null;
    case "array": return Array.isArray(value) && value.every((item: unknown) => matches(item, validator.element));
    case "union": return validator.members.some((member: GenericValidator) => matches(value, member));
    case "object": {
      if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
      const record = value as Record<string, unknown>; const fields: Record<string, GenericValidator> = validator.fields;
      return Object.keys(record).every((key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(fields, key))
        && Object.entries(fields).every(([key, field]) => record[key] === undefined ? field.isOptional === "optional" : matches(record[key], field));
    }
    default: return false;
  }
}
export type RegistryTable = "agents" | "memorySpaces" | "contexts";
export function insertionShape(table: RegistryTable, value: Record<string, unknown>) {
  if (!matches(value, schema.tables[table].validator)) deny("INVALID_INPUT");
}
export function snapshot(value: unknown): string {
  // Convex's codec sorts object keys and preserves bytes, int64, special floats and signed zero.
  return value === undefined ? "undefined" : JSON.stringify(nativeJson(value));
}
export function canonical(table: RegistryTable, row: Doc<RegistryTable>): void {
  const { _id: _unusedId, _creationTime: _unusedCreation, ...value } = row;
  if (!matches(value, schema.tables[table].validator) || !row.tenantId?.trim() || !row.ownerPrincipalId?.trim() || row.tombstonedAt !== undefined) deny();
  const start = table === "agents" ? (row as Doc<"agents">).registeredAt : (row as Doc<"contexts">).createdAt;
  if (start < 0 || row.updatedAt < start || row.updatedAt > 8.64e15) deny();
  if (table === "memorySpaces") distinct((row as Doc<"memorySpaces">).participants.map((p) => p.id));
  if (table === "contexts") {
    const c = row as Doc<"contexts">;
    if (c.lastUpdatedBy !== undefined && !c.lastUpdatedBy.trim()) deny();
    integer(c.version, 1, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER); integer(c.depth, 0, 100);
    distinct(c.childIds); distinct(c.participants);
    if (!c.rootId || c.contextId === c.parentId || c.childIds.includes(c.contextId)
      || c.previousVersions.length !== c.version - 1 || c.previousVersions.length > 1000) deny();
    let timestamp = c.createdAt;
    for (let index = 0; index < c.previousVersions.length; index++) {
      const history = c.previousVersions[index]!;
      if (history.version !== index + 1 || history.timestamp < timestamp || history.timestamp > c.updatedAt
        || !["active", "completed", "cancelled", "blocked"].includes(history.status)
        || history.updatedBy !== undefined && !history.updatedBy.trim()) deny();
      timestamp = history.timestamp;
    }
    if (c.grantedAccess) distinct(c.grantedAccess.map((grant) => grant.memorySpaceId));
  }
}
export function resource(table: RegistryTable, row: { tenantId?: string; memorySpaceId?: string; ownerPrincipalId?: string; agentId?: string; contextId?: string }): RuntimeResource {
  return { resourceType: table === "agents" ? "source" : table === "contexts" ? "context" : "memorySpace",
    // Agent labels live in the existing source resource namespace with collision-safe tuple IDs.
    resourceId: table === "agents" ? JSON.stringify(["agents", row.agentId]) : table === "contexts" ? row.contextId! : row.memorySpaceId!,
    tenantId: row.tenantId, memorySpaceId: row.memorySpaceId, ownerPrincipalId: row.ownerPrincipalId };
}

/** Every admitted capability and canonical snapshot survives the entire transaction. */
export class RegistryAccess {
  readonly checks: { authority: RuntimeAuthority; requirement: RuntimeAuthorityRequirement }[] = [];
  readonly witnesses = new Map<string, { expected: string; reload: () => Promise<unknown> }>();
  private readonly readDecisions = new Map<string, boolean>();
  private readonly retiredResources = new Map<string, number>();
  private constructor(readonly ctx: RegistryCtx, readonly authority: RuntimeAuthority, readonly capability: RuntimeCapability) {}
  static async open(ctx: RegistryCtx, capability: RuntimeCapability, scope: Selectors) {
    const authority = await requireRegistryAuthority(ctx, { capability, ...scope });
    const access = new RegistryAccess(ctx, authority, capability);
    access.keep(authority, { capability, tenantId: authority.tenantId, memorySpaceId: authority.memorySpaceId });
    return access;
  }
  keep(authority: RuntimeAuthority, requirement: RuntimeAuthorityRequirement) {
    const key = JSON.stringify([authority.grantId, authority.memorySpaceId, requirement]);
    if (!this.checks.some((check) => JSON.stringify([check.authority.grantId, check.authority.memorySpaceId, check.requirement]) === key)) this.checks.push({ authority, requirement });
  }
  async admit(rowResource: RuntimeResource, capability = this.capability): Promise<RuntimeAuthority> {
    const authority = await requireRegistryAuthority(this.ctx, { capability, resource: rowResource });
    if (authority.principalId !== this.authority.principalId || authority.tenantId !== this.authority.tenantId) deny();
    this.keep(authority, { capability, tenantId: authority.tenantId, memorySpaceId: authority.memorySpaceId });
    this.keep(authority, { capability, resource: rowResource }); return authority;
  }
  async optionalRead(rowResource: RuntimeResource): Promise<boolean> {
    const key = JSON.stringify(rowResource); const initial = this.readDecisions.get(key);
    if (initial !== undefined) return initial;
    try { await this.admit(rowResource, "read"); this.readDecisions.set(key, true); return true; }
    catch (error) { if (safeErrorCode(error) === "FORBIDDEN") { this.readDecisions.set(key, false); return false; } throw error; }
  }
  async readAll(resources: RuntimeResource[]): Promise<boolean> {
    let readable = true;
    for (const rowResource of resources) if (!await this.optionalRead(rowResource)) readable = false;
    return readable;
  }
  witness(key: string, row: unknown, reload: () => Promise<unknown>) {
    const expected = snapshot(row); const existing = this.witnesses.get(key);
    if (existing && existing.expected !== expected) deny();
    if (!existing) this.witnesses.set(key, { expected, reload });
  }
  expect(key: string, row: unknown) { const witness = this.witnesses.get(key); if (witness) witness.expected = snapshot(row); }
  retainTombstone(rowResource: RuntimeResource, deletedAt: number) {
    const key = { tenantId: rowResource.tenantId!, memorySpaceId: rowResource.memorySpaceId,
      resourceType: rowResource.resourceType, resourceId: rowResource.resourceId };
    const reload = async () => {
      const row = await this.ctx.db.query("runtimeAuthTombstones").withIndex("by_resource", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", key.tenantId)
        .eq("memorySpaceId", key.memorySpaceId).eq("resourceType", key.resourceType).eq("resourceId", key.resourceId)).unique();
      return row ? { tenantId: row.tenantId, memorySpaceId: row.memorySpaceId, resourceType: row.resourceType, resourceId: row.resourceId, deletedAt: row.deletedAt } : null;
    };
    this.witness(`retired:${JSON.stringify(key)}`, { ...key, deletedAt }, reload);
  }
  retire(rowResource: RuntimeResource, deletedAt: number) {
    this.retainTombstone(rowResource, deletedAt);
    // Keep resource READ/WRITE/ADMIN eligibility too: retirement cannot erase a private-output witness.
    this.retiredResources.set(snapshot({ tenantId: rowResource.tenantId, memorySpaceId: rowResource.memorySpaceId,
      resourceType: rowResource.resourceType, resourceId: rowResource.resourceId }), deletedAt);
  }
  private reader() {
    const base = registryReader(this.ctx, true);
    return { ...base, hasTombstone: async (key: TombstoneKey) => {
      const deletedAt = this.retiredResources.get(snapshot(key));
      if (deletedAt === undefined) return await base.hasTombstone(key);
      const row = await this.ctx.db.query("runtimeAuthTombstones").withIndex("by_resource", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", key.tenantId)
        .eq("memorySpaceId", key.memorySpaceId).eq("resourceType", key.resourceType).eq("resourceId", key.resourceId)).unique();
      if (!row || row.deletedAt !== deletedAt) deny(); return false;
    } };
  }
  /** Final deletion barrier accepts only this transaction's exact new space fence. Principal,
   * membership, immutable grants, tenant fences and all other resource fences remain current.
   * It cannot admit a later operation: open() fails on the retired space before this object exists. */
  async fenceRetiredSpace(expected: { memorySpaceId: string; epoch: number; deletedAt: number }) {
    const base = this.reader(); const tenantId = this.authority.tenantId;
    const reader = { ...base,
      getScope: async (tenant: string, space?: string) => {
        const scope = await base.getScope(tenant, space);
        if (tenant !== tenantId || space !== expected.memorySpaceId) return scope;
        if (!scope || scope.epoch !== expected.epoch || scope.deletedAt !== expected.deletedAt) deny();
        return { ...scope, epoch: expected.epoch - 1, deletedAt: undefined };
      },
      hasTombstone: async (key: Parameters<typeof base.hasTombstone>[0]) => {
        if (key.tenantId !== tenantId || key.memorySpaceId !== expected.memorySpaceId
          || key.resourceType !== "memorySpace" || key.resourceId !== expected.memorySpaceId) return await base.hasTombstone(key);
        const row = await this.ctx.db.query("runtimeAuthTombstones").withIndex("by_resource", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", tenantId)
          .eq("memorySpaceId", expected.memorySpaceId).eq("resourceType", "memorySpace").eq("resourceId", expected.memorySpaceId)).unique();
        if (!row || row.deletedAt !== expected.deletedAt) deny(); return false;
      },
    };
    let previous: string | undefined;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
      const snapshots: string[] = [];
      for (const check of this.checks) snapshots.push(JSON.stringify(await resolveAuthorityReference(reader, check.authority, check.requirement)));
      for (const witness of this.witnesses.values()) {
        const actual = snapshot(await witness.reload()); if (actual !== witness.expected) deny(); snapshots.push(actual);
      }
      const current = JSON.stringify(snapshots); if (current === previous) return; previous = current;
    }
    deny();
  }
  /** Two matching complete sweeps prevent a late check from hiding changes to an earlier admitted row/grant.
   * Real Convex reads/effects share an atomic snapshot; bounded convergence also checks adversarial awaited fixtures. */
  async fence() {
    const reader = this.reader();
    let previous: string | undefined;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
      const snapshots: string[] = [];
      for (const check of this.checks) snapshots.push(JSON.stringify(await resolveAuthorityReference(reader, check.authority, check.requirement)));
      for (const witness of this.witnesses.values()) {
        const actual = snapshot(await witness.reload());
        if (actual !== witness.expected) deny(); snapshots.push(actual);
      }
      const current = JSON.stringify(snapshots);
      if (current === previous) return;
      previous = current;
    }
    deny();
  }
}
function owner(authority: RuntimeAuthority): string | undefined { return authority.resourceAccess === "own" ? authority.principalId : undefined; }
export async function agentsIn(access: RegistryAccess) {
  const a = access.authority;
  return await access.ctx.db.query("agents").withIndex("by_runtime_scope_owner", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", a.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", a.memorySpaceId))
    .filter((q) => q.and(q.eq(q.field("tombstonedAt"), undefined), owner(a) ? q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), a.principalId) : q.neq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), undefined))).collect();
}
export async function agentAt(access: RegistryAccess, id: string, required = true) {
  textId(id); const a = access.authority;
  const load = async () => await access.ctx.db.query("agents").withIndex("by_runtime_scope_agent", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", a.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", a.memorySpaceId).eq("agentId", id))
    .filter((q) => owner(a) ? q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), a.principalId) : q.neq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), undefined)).unique();
  const row = await load();
  if (!row) { if (required) deny(); return null; }
  canonical("agents", row); await access.admit(resource("agents", row)); if (access.capability === "write") await uniqueKey(access, "agents", row.agentId, row.memorySpaceId); access.witness(`agents:${row._id}`, row, load); return row;
}
export async function spaceAt(access: RegistryAccess, id: string, capability = access.capability, required = true) {
  textId(id); const admitted = await requireRegistryAuthority(access.ctx, { capability, tenantId: access.authority.tenantId, memorySpaceId: id });
  const load = async () => await access.ctx.db.query("memorySpaces").withIndex("by_tenant_memorySpaceId", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", admitted.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", id))
    .filter((q) => owner(admitted) ? q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), admitted.principalId) : q.neq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), undefined)).unique();
  access.keep(admitted, { capability, tenantId: admitted.tenantId, memorySpaceId: id });
  const row = await load();
  if (!row) { if (required) deny(); return null; }
  canonical("memorySpaces", row); await access.admit(resource("memorySpaces", row), capability); if (capability === "write") await uniqueKey(access, "memorySpaces", row.memorySpaceId, row.memorySpaceId); access.witness(`memorySpaces:${row._id}`, row, load); return row;
}
async function admittedSpaces(access: RegistryAccess) {
  const a = access.authority;
  const scopes = a.memorySpaceId === undefined
    ? await access.ctx.db.query("runtimeAuthScopes").withIndex("by_tenant_space", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", a.tenantId)).collect()
    : [{ tenantId: a.tenantId, memorySpaceId: a.memorySpaceId, deletedAt: undefined }];
  const result: RuntimeAuthority[] = [];
  for (const scope of scopes) {
    if (!scope.memorySpaceId || scope.deletedAt !== undefined) continue;
    let authority: RuntimeAuthority;
    try { authority = await requireRegistryAuthority(access.ctx, { capability: access.capability, tenantId: a.tenantId, memorySpaceId: scope.memorySpaceId }); }
    catch (error) { if (safeErrorCode(error) === "FORBIDDEN") continue; throw error; }
    access.keep(authority, { capability: access.capability, tenantId: authority.tenantId, memorySpaceId: authority.memorySpaceId }); result.push(authority);
  }
  return result;
}
export async function spacesIn(access: RegistryAccess) {
  const result: Doc<"memorySpaces">[] = [];
  for (const a of await admittedSpaces(access)) {
    const rows = await access.ctx.db.query("memorySpaces").withIndex("by_tenant_memorySpaceId", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", a.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", a.memorySpaceId!))
      .filter((q) => q.and(q.eq(q.field("tombstonedAt"), undefined), owner(a) ? q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), a.principalId) : q.neq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), undefined))).collect();
    for (const row of rows) { const current = await spaceAt(access, row.memorySpaceId); if (snapshot(current) !== snapshot(row)) deny(); result.push(row); }
  }
  return result;
}
/** Candidate spaces come solely from trusted scope controls; labels/participants/grantedAccess never grant access. */
export async function contextAt(access: RegistryAccess, id: string, crossSpace = false, required = true) {
  textId(id); const a = access.authority;
  const scopes = crossSpace || a.memorySpaceId === undefined
    ? await access.ctx.db.query("runtimeAuthScopes").withIndex("by_tenant_space", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", a.tenantId)).collect()
    : [{ tenantId: a.tenantId, memorySpaceId: a.memorySpaceId, deletedAt: undefined }];
  const matches: Doc<"contexts">[] = [];
  for (const scope of scopes) {
    if (!scope.memorySpaceId || scope.deletedAt !== undefined) continue;
    let admitted: RuntimeAuthority;
    try { admitted = await requireRegistryAuthority(access.ctx, { capability: access.capability, tenantId: a.tenantId, memorySpaceId: scope.memorySpaceId }); }
    catch (error) { if (safeErrorCode(error) === "FORBIDDEN") continue; throw error; }
    const load = async () => await access.ctx.db.query("contexts").withIndex("by_runtime_scope_context", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", a.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", scope.memorySpaceId!).eq("contextId", id))
      .filter((q) => owner(admitted) ? q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), admitted.principalId) : q.neq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), undefined)).unique();
    const row = await load(); if (!row) continue;
    canonical("contexts", row); await access.admit(resource("contexts", row)); if (access.capability === "write") await uniqueKey(access, "contexts", row.contextId, row.memorySpaceId); access.witness(`contexts:${row._id}`, row, load); matches.push(row);
  }
  if (matches.length > 1 || matches.length === 0 && required) deny(); return matches[0] ?? null;
}
export async function contextsIn(access: RegistryAccess) {
  const result: Doc<"contexts">[] = [];
  for (const a of await admittedSpaces(access)) {
    const rows = await access.ctx.db.query("contexts").withIndex("by_runtime_scope_owner", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", a.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", a.memorySpaceId!))
      .filter((q) => q.and(q.eq(q.field("tombstonedAt"), undefined), owner(a) ? q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), a.principalId) : q.neq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), undefined))).collect();
    for (const row of rows) { canonical("contexts", row); const current = await contextAt(access, row.contextId, true); if (snapshot(current) !== snapshot(row)) deny(); result.push(row); }
  }
  return result;
}
export async function tombstone(ctx: MutationCtx, rowResource: RuntimeResource, deletedAt = Date.now()) {
  if (!rowResource.tenantId) deny();
  const key = { tenantId: rowResource.tenantId, memorySpaceId: rowResource.memorySpaceId, resourceType: rowResource.resourceType, resourceId: rowResource.resourceId };
  if (!await registryReader(ctx).hasTombstone(key)) await effect(ctx, async () => await ctx.db.insert("runtimeAuthTombstones", { ...key, deletedAt }));
}
export function receipt(table: RegistryTable, id: string) { return { accepted: true as const, resourceType: table, resourceId: id }; }

/** Mutation-only uniqueness fence after owner-filtered target admission. Convex fetches the
 * exact-key server document (or detects more than one); only Boolean existence/uniqueness survives.
 * Its payload is never used as a canonical candidate, permission, processed input, log or response. */
async function uniqueKey(access: RegistryAccess, table: RegistryTable, id: string, memorySpaceId?: string) {
  const tenantId = access.authority.tenantId;
  const probe = table === "agents" ? async () => (await access.ctx.db.query("agents")
    .withIndex("by_runtime_scope_agent", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", memorySpaceId).eq("agentId", id)).unique()) !== null
    : table === "memorySpaces" ? async () => (await access.ctx.db.query("memorySpaces")
      .withIndex("by_tenant_memorySpaceId", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", id)).unique()) !== null
    : async () => (await access.ctx.db.query("contexts")
      .withIndex("by_runtime_scope_context", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", memorySpaceId!).eq("contextId", id)).unique()) !== null;
  const load = async () => await probe();
  if (!await load()) deny(); access.witness(`unique:${table}:${id}:${memorySpaceId ?? ""}`, true, load);
}

/** The first insert expectation comes only from validated local values and the native returned ID.
 * Convex assigns _creationTime; all application fields/owner/lifecycle and ID remain exact witnesses. */
export async function inserted(access: RegistryAccess, table: RegistryTable, id: string,
  value: Record<string, unknown> & { tenantId: string; ownerPrincipalId: string; memorySpaceId?: string; agentId?: string; contextId?: string }) {
  const load = table === "agents" ? async () => await access.ctx.db.query("agents")
    .withIndex("by_runtime_scope_agent", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", value.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", value.memorySpaceId).eq("agentId", value.agentId!))
    .filter((q) => q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), value.ownerPrincipalId)).unique()
    : table === "memorySpaces" ? async () => await access.ctx.db.query("memorySpaces")
      .withIndex("by_tenant_memorySpaceId", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", value.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", value.memorySpaceId!))
      .filter((q) => q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), value.ownerPrincipalId)).unique()
    : async () => await access.ctx.db.query("contexts")
      .withIndex("by_runtime_scope_context", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", value.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", value.memorySpaceId!).eq("contextId", value.contextId!))
      .filter((q) => q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), value.ownerPrincipalId)).unique();
  access.witness(`inserted:${table}:${id}`, { ...value, _id: id }, async () => {
    const row = await load(); if (!row) return null;
    const { _creationTime: _unusedCreationTime, ...payload } = row; return payload;
  });
  await uniqueKey(access, table, table === "agents" ? value.agentId! : table === "contexts" ? value.contextId! : value.memorySpaceId!, value.memorySpaceId);
}

/** Convex has no indexed existence projection. This exact-key collision fence necessarily fetches
 * one full server document, immediately discards it and retains only a Boolean. It must never use
 * payload/owner/config for admission, processing, logs or delivery. This is the documented exception
 * to owner-before-hydration; ordinary lookup, hierarchy, bulk and delivery retain owner predicates. */
export async function conflict(access: RegistryAccess, table: RegistryTable, id: string) {
  const a = access.authority;
  const load = table === "agents" ? async () => (await access.ctx.db.query("agents")
    .withIndex("by_runtime_scope_agent", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", a.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", a.memorySpaceId).eq("agentId", id)).first()) !== null
    : table === "memorySpaces" ? async () => (await access.ctx.db.query("memorySpaces")
      .withIndex("by_tenant_memorySpaceId", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", a.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", id)).first()) !== null
    : async () => (await access.ctx.db.query("contexts")
      .withIndex("by_runtime_scope_context", (q) => q.eq("tenantId", a.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", a.memorySpaceId!).eq("contextId", id)).first()) !== null;
  const exists = await load(); if (exists) deny(); access.witness(`conflict:${table}:${id}`, false, load);
}

/** Independent structural seam for Task03T/05. No current row can establish a trusted owner:
 * do not hydrate transcript/private fields merely to discover that ownership is absent. */
export interface TrustedConversationMetadata {
  conversationId: string; tenantId: string; memorySpaceId: string; ownerPrincipalId: string;
  createdAt: number; updatedAt: number; tombstonedAt?: number;
  messageAnchors: { id: string; role: "user" | "agent"; timestamp: number }[];
}
export async function conversationAt(access: RegistryAccess, ref: { conversationId: string; messageIds?: string[] }, space: string): Promise<TrustedConversationMetadata> {
  textId(ref.conversationId); if (ref.messageIds) distinct(ref.messageIds);
  const authority = await requireRegistryAuthority(access.ctx, { capability: "read", tenantId: access.authority.tenantId, memorySpaceId: space });
  access.keep(authority, { capability: "read", tenantId: authority.tenantId, memorySpaceId: space });
  // Current conversation schema has no trusted owner; a metadata-only reference never adopts one.
  // Task03T must implement owner/lifecycle and every message-anchor check before this seam can deliver.
  await access.fence(); return deny("CAPABILITY_NOT_READY");
}

FILE convex-dev/runtimeWorkerAuth.ts SHA256 dd5edc4b38263c3ebd6ee4a81301182aac7659e80e3527fe21ab93f06031a92e
/** Independent worker/operator boundary derived only from reviewed runtimeAuth/02B. */
import { ConvexError, v, type GenericValidator } from "convex/values";
import type { MutationCtx, QueryCtx } from "./_generated/server";
import type { Doc, Id } from "./_generated/dataModel";
import type { RuntimeAuthority, RuntimeAuthorityReference, RuntimeCapability } from "../src/auth/verified";
import { recheckAuthority } from "./runtimeAuth";
import { assertSourceLineage } from "../src/domain/sources";
import { normalizeSourceText, semanticHash } from "../src/domain/profile";
import { canonicalMemoryValue } from "./runtimeMemoryRepository";

export function workerDeny(code: "FORBIDDEN" | "INVALID_INPUT" | "UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION" = "FORBIDDEN"): never {
  throw new ConvexError({ version: 1, code, message: code === "UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION"
    ? "Resource lifecycle is not supported by this maintenance adapter" : "Access denied or invalid worker input",
  retryable: false, outcome: "not_dispatched" });
}
export function boundedInteger(value: number, max = 1000, min = 1): number {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < min || value > max) workerDeny("INVALID_INPUT");
  return value;
}
export function authorityReference(authority: RuntimeAuthority): RuntimeAuthorityReference {
  const { principalId, principalVersion, membershipId, membershipVersion, grantId, grantVersion,
    tenantId, tenantEpoch, memorySpaceId, memorySpaceEpoch } = authority;
  return { principalId, principalVersion, membershipId, membershipVersion, grantId, grantVersion,
    tenantId, tenantEpoch, ...(memorySpaceId === undefined ? {} : { memorySpaceId, memorySpaceEpoch }) };
}
export function sameAuthority(a: RuntimeAuthorityReference, b: RuntimeAuthorityReference): boolean {
  return canonicalMemoryValue(authorityReferenceFields(a)) === canonicalMemoryValue(authorityReferenceFields(b));
}
function authorityReferenceFields(a: RuntimeAuthorityReference) {
  return [a.principalId, a.principalVersion, a.membershipId, a.membershipVersion, a.grantId, a.grantVersion,
    a.tenantId, a.tenantEpoch, a.memorySpaceId ?? null, a.memorySpaceEpoch ?? null];
}
export async function workerAuthority(ctx: Pick<QueryCtx, "db">, reference: RuntimeAuthorityReference, capability: RuntimeCapability) {
  if (!reference.memorySpaceId) workerDeny();
  return await recheckAuthority(ctx, reference, { capability, tenantId: reference.tenantId, memorySpaceId: reference.memorySpaceId });
}

/** Strict structural validation is also applied to persisted JSON and direct handler fixtures. */
export function matchesValidator(value: unknown, schema: GenericValidator): boolean {
  switch (schema.kind) {
    case "string": case "id": return typeof value === "string" && value.trim().length > 0;
    case "float64": return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value);
    case "boolean": return typeof value === "boolean";
    case "null": return value === null;
    case "literal": return value === schema.value;
    case "array": return Array.isArray(value) && value.every((item: unknown) => matchesValidator(item, schema.element));
    case "union": return schema.members.some((member: GenericValidator) => matchesValidator(value, member));
    case "object": {
      if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
      const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
      const fields: Record<string, GenericValidator> = schema.fields;
      return Object.keys(record).every((key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(fields, key))
        && Object.entries(fields).every(([key, field]) => record[key] === undefined
          ? field.isOptional === "optional" : matchesValidator(record[key], field));
    }
    case "record": return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)
      && Object.entries(value).every(([key, item]) => matchesValidator(key, schema.key) && matchesValidator(item, schema.value));
    default: return false;
  }
}

function validStoredTime(value: number): boolean {
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 8.64e15;
}

type FactExpectation = { documentId?: Id<"facts">; version: number; sourceId: string; sourceEventId: string; sourceRevision: number };
function validateFact(fact: Doc<"facts"> | null, expected: FactExpectation): asserts fact is Doc<"facts"> {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!fact || !fact.ownerPrincipalId || !fact.lineage || !fact.extractionPolicyVersion?.trim()
    || (expected.documentId !== undefined && expected.documentId !== fact._id)
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(fact.version) || fact.version < 1 || fact.version !== expected.version
    || !Number.isFinite(fact.confidence) || fact.confidence < 0 || fact.confidence > 100
    || !validStoredTime(fact.createdAt) || !validStoredTime(fact.updatedAt) || fact.updatedAt < fact.createdAt
    || fact.tombstonedAt !== undefined || fact.supersededBy !== undefined
    || (fact.validFrom !== undefined && (!validStoredTime(fact.validFrom) || fact.validFrom > now))
    || (fact.validUntil !== undefined && (!validStoredTime(fact.validUntil) || fact.validUntil <= now))
    || (fact.validFrom !== undefined && fact.validUntil !== undefined && fact.validUntil <= fact.validFrom)
    || fact.lineage.sourceId !== expected.sourceId || fact.lineage.sourceEventId !== expected.sourceEventId
    || fact.lineage.sourceRevision !== expected.sourceRevision || fact.lineage.role === "assistant"
    || (fact.sourceType !== "manual" && fact.sourceType !== "tool")
    || (fact.sourceType === "tool") !== (fact.lineage.role === "tool")) workerDeny();
  assertSourceLineage(fact.lineage);
}
function validateSource(source: Doc<"runtimeMemorySources"> | null, fact: Doc<"facts">): asserts source is Doc<"runtimeMemorySources"> {
  if (!source || !validStoredTime(source.createdAt) || source.ownerPrincipalId !== fact.ownerPrincipalId
    || source.tenantId !== fact.tenantId || source.memorySpaceId !== fact.memorySpaceId || source.tombstonedAt !== undefined
    || canonicalMemoryValue(source.lineage) !== canonicalMemoryValue(fact.lineage)
    || normalizeSourceText(source.content) !== source.content) workerDeny();
  assertSourceLineage(source.lineage);
}
async function scopedFact(ctx: Pick<QueryCtx, "db">, authority: RuntimeAuthority, factId: string) {
  return await ctx.db.query("facts").withIndex("by_runtime_scope_factId", (q) =>
    q.eq("tenantId", authority.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", authority.memorySpaceId!).eq("factId", factId))
    .filter((q) => authority.resourceAccess === "own" ? q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), authority.principalId)
      : q.eq(q.field("tenantId"), authority.tenantId)).unique();
}
async function scopedSource(ctx: Pick<QueryCtx, "db">, authority: RuntimeAuthority, sourceId: string) {
  return await ctx.db.query("runtimeMemorySources").withIndex("by_scope_source", (q) =>
    q.eq("tenantId", authority.tenantId).eq("memorySpaceId", authority.memorySpaceId!).eq("lineage.sourceId", sourceId))
    .filter((q) => authority.resourceAccess === "own" ? q.eq(q.field("ownerPrincipalId"), authority.principalId)
      : q.eq(q.field("tenantId"), authority.tenantId)).unique();
}
/** Canonical fact/source checks precede private use. Final reloads follow all crypto/authority awaits. */
export async function canonicalFact(ctx: Pick<QueryCtx, "db">, reference: RuntimeAuthorityReference,
  factId: string, expected: FactExpectation) {
  const authority = await workerAuthority(ctx, reference, "tool");
  await workerAuthority(ctx, reference, "read");
  await recheckAuthority(ctx, reference, { capability: "read", resource: { resourceType: "fact", resourceId: factId,
    tenantId: authority.tenantId, memorySpaceId: authority.memorySpaceId, ownerPrincipalId: authority.principalId } });
  const fact = await scopedFact(ctx, authority, factId);
  validateFact(fact, expected);
  const resource = { resourceType: "fact" as const, resourceId: fact.factId, tenantId: fact.tenantId,
    memorySpaceId: fact.memorySpaceId, ownerPrincipalId: fact.ownerPrincipalId };
  const sourceResource = { resourceType: "source" as const, resourceId: expected.sourceId,
    tenantId: fact.tenantId, memorySpaceId: fact.memorySpaceId, ownerPrincipalId: fact.ownerPrincipalId };
  await recheckAuthority(ctx, reference, { capability: "read", resource });
  await recheckAuthority(ctx, reference, { capability: "read", resource: sourceResource });
  const source = await scopedSource(ctx, authority, expected.sourceId);
  validateSource(source, fact);
  const factSnapshot = canonicalMemoryValue(fact);
  const sourceSnapshot = canonicalMemoryValue(source);
  const actualHash = await semanticHash(source.content);
  if (actualHash !== source.contentHash) workerDeny();
  // Source fences are independent of fact fences. Both explicit capabilities remain current after digest.
  await recheckAuthority(ctx, reference, { capability: "tool", resource });
  await recheckAuthority(ctx, reference, { capability: "tool", resource: sourceResource });
  await recheckAuthority(ctx, reference, { capability: "read", resource });
  await recheckAuthority(ctx, reference, { capability: "read", resource: sourceResource });
  // Reload canonical rows after those checkpoints. Exact snapshots prove the reloaded bytes match
  // the verified digest without introducing another asynchronous digest after the final checks.
  // Convex reads/writes share one transaction snapshot; fixture hooks model changes at awaited seams.
  const currentFact = await scopedFact(ctx, authority, factId);
  const currentSource = await scopedSource(ctx, authority, expected.sourceId);
  validateFact(currentFact, expected);
  validateSource(currentSource, currentFact);
  if (canonicalMemoryValue(currentFact) !== factSnapshot || canonicalMemoryValue(currentSource) !== sourceSnapshot
    || currentSource.contentHash !== actualHash) workerDeny();
  return currentFact;
}

export async function canonicalJob(ctx: Pick<QueryCtx, "db">, reference: RuntimeAuthorityReference, item: Doc<"graphSyncQueue">) {
  if (!item.authority || !sameAuthority(item.authority, reference) || item.tenantId !== reference.tenantId
    || item.memorySpaceId !== reference.memorySpaceId || !item.ownerPrincipalId || item.table !== "facts"
    || !item.entityDocumentId || item.entityVersion === undefined || !item.sourceId || !item.sourceEventId
    || item.sourceRevision === undefined || item.operation === "delete"
    || !validStoredTime(item.createdAt)
    || (item.syncedAt !== undefined && (!validStoredTime(item.syncedAt) || item.syncedAt < item.createdAt))) workerDeny();
  const fact = await canonicalFact(ctx, item.authority, item.entityId, { documentId: item.entityDocumentId,
    version: item.entityVersion, sourceId: item.sourceId, sourceEventId: item.sourceEventId, sourceRevision: item.sourceRevision });
  if (item.ownerPrincipalId !== fact.ownerPrincipalId || canonicalMemoryValue(item.entity) !== canonicalMemoryValue(factPayload(fact))) workerDeny();
  return fact;
}
export function factPayload(fact: Doc<"facts">) {
  return { factId: fact.factId, fact: fact.fact, factType: fact.factType, confidence: fact.confidence, version: fact.version,
    tenantId: fact.tenantId!, memorySpaceId: fact.memorySpaceId, ownerPrincipalId: fact.ownerPrincipalId!, lineage: fact.lineage!,
    tags: fact.tags, ...(fact.subject === undefined ? {} : { subject: fact.subject }),
    ...(fact.predicate === undefined ? {} : { predicate: fact.predicate }), ...(fact.object === undefined ? {} : { object: fact.object }),
    ...(fact.entities === undefined ? {} : { entities: fact.entities }), ...(fact.relations === undefined ? {} : { relations: fact.relations }) };
}

export const maintenanceTable = v.union(v.literal("agents"), v.literal("artifacts"), v.literal("contexts"),
  v.literal("conversations"), v.literal("factHistory"), v.literal("facts"), v.literal("governanceEnforcement"),
  v.literal("governancePolicies"), v.literal("graphSyncQueue"), v.literal("immutable"), v.literal("memories"),
  v.literal("memorySpaces"), v.literal("mutable"), v.literal("sessions"));
export type MaintenanceTable = typeof maintenanceTable.type;
export function assertMaintenanceTable(table: MaintenanceTable): void {
  if (!matchesValidator(table, maintenanceTable)) workerDeny("INVALID_INPUT");
}
export function assertDeletionSupported(table: MaintenanceTable): void {
  assertMaintenanceTable(table);
  if (table !== "governancePolicies" && table !== "governanceEnforcement" && table !== "graphSyncQueue") workerDeny("UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION");
}
/** Operator-only metadata cleanup. Auth/source/tombstone controls are never allowlisted. */
export async function deleteMaintenanceRecord(ctx: MutationCtx, table: MaintenanceTable, rawId: string) {
  assertMaintenanceTable(table);
  const id = ctx.db.normalizeId(table, rawId);
  if (!id) workerDeny("INVALID_INPUT"); // Validate the table/ID pair before destructive routing.
  assertDeletionSupported(table);
  if (table === "governancePolicies") {
    const policyId = ctx.db.normalizeId("governancePolicies", rawId)!;
    const row = await ctx.db.get("governancePolicies", policyId);
    if (!row) return false;
    const references = await ctx.db.query("governanceEnforcement").withIndex("by_runtime_policy", (q) => q.eq("policyId", policyId)).collect();
    for (const log of references) await ctx.db.delete("governanceEnforcement", log._id);
    await ctx.db.delete("governancePolicies", policyId);
  } else if (table === "governanceEnforcement") {
    const rowId = ctx.db.normalizeId("governanceEnforcement", rawId)!;
    if (!await ctx.db.get("governanceEnforcement", rowId)) return false;
    await ctx.db.delete("governanceEnforcement", rowId);
  } else {
    const rowId = ctx.db.normalizeId("graphSyncQueue", rawId)!;
    if (!await ctx.db.get("graphSyncQueue", rowId)) return false;
    await ctx.db.delete("graphSyncQueue", rowId);
  }
  return true;
}

/**
 * Cortex SDK - Convex Schema
 *
 * Layer 1: ACID Stores
 * - conversations (Layer 1a) - Immutable conversation history (memorySpace-scoped)
 * - immutable (Layer 1b) - Versioned immutable data (TRULY shared, NO memorySpace)
 * - mutable (Layer 1c) - Live operational data (TRULY shared, NO memorySpace)
 *
 * Layer 2: Vector Index
 * - memories - Searchable knowledge with embeddings (memorySpace-scoped)
 *
 * Layer 3: Facts Store
 * - facts - LLM-extracted facts (memorySpace-scoped, versioned)
 *
 * Layer 4: Convenience APIs (SDK only, no schema)
 *
 * Artifacts
 * - artifacts - Interactive versioned documents (memorySpace-scoped, streaming support)
 *
 * Attachments (Multi-modal)
 * - attachments - Multi-modal file storage (images, PDFs, audio, video, files)
 *
 * Coordination:
 * - contexts - Hierarchical context chains (memorySpace-scoped, cross-space support)
 * - memorySpaces - Memory space registry (Hive/Collaboration modes)
 * - agents - Optional agent metadata registry (analytics, discovery, team organization)
 */

import { defineSchema, defineTable } from "convex/server";
import { v } from "convex/values";
import { runtimeAuthorityReference, runtimeAuthTables } from "./runtimeAuthSchema";
import { runtimeMemoryTables, sourceLineage } from "./runtimeMemorySchema";
import { runtimePolicyTables } from "./runtimePolicySchema";

export default defineSchema({
  ...runtimeAuthTables,
  ...runtimeMemoryTables,
  ...runtimePolicyTables,
  // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  conversations: defineTable({
    // Identity
    conversationId: v.string(), // Unique ID (e.g., "conv-abc123")

    // Memory Space (NEW - fundamental isolation boundary)
    memorySpaceId: v.string(), // Which memory space owns this conversation
    participantId: v.optional(v.string()), // Hive Mode: which participant created this

    // Multi-tenancy (NEW - critical for SaaS isolation)
    tenantId: v.optional(v.string()), // Tenant ID for isolation

    // Type: user-agent (user ↔ participant) or agent-agent (space ↔ space)
    type: v.union(v.literal("user-agent"), v.literal("agent-agent")),

    // Participants (based on type)
    participants: v.object({
      // user-agent conversations (single user)
      userId: v.optional(v.string()), // The primary human user in the conversation
      agentId: v.optional(v.string()), // The agent/assistant in the conversation

      // Collaborative conversations (Phase 4) - multiple human participants
      userIds: v.optional(v.array(v.string())), // Multiple human users

      // Hive Mode tracking (which tool/agent in shared space created this)
      participantId: v.optional(v.string()),

      // agent-agent conversations (Collaboration Mode - cross-space)
      memorySpaceIds: v.optional(v.array(v.string())), // Both spaces involved
    }),

        metadata: v.optional(v.any()), // Flexible metadata
        attachmentIds: v.optional(v.array(v.string())), // Multi-modal attachment references

        // Collaborative approval (Phase 4)
        approvalStatus: v.optional(
          v.union(

            v.literal("rejected"),

    // Timestamps

    updatedAt: v.number(),

    // - 'private': Only owner can access (default)

  conversationShares: defineTable({

  // Conversation Snapshots (Shareable Chats Phase 3)
